premises.text: College students and other busy people lack time and skill to cook healthy home meals
premises.evidence_span: We'll have limited time and ability to make food. Many of us don't know how to cook

premises.text: Cookie is a push-button robotic cooker that prepares meals from pre-portioned fresh ingredient trays
premises.evidence_span: Cookie, a push-of-a-button automated cooking device from Serenity Kitchen

premises.text: Hardware combines food-tray storage/delivery, induction cooktop, and robotic arm for timed manipulated cooking
premises.evidence_span: Cookie captures these things with a storage and delivery mechanism for food trays, a safe induction cooktop, and of course, the robotic arm

premises.text: Foodie app selects recipes, buys from a recipe store, schedules cooks, and monitors progress
premises.evidence_span: Foodie presents a clean, simple interface to connect a user with his or her food choices

premises.text: Chefs and home cooks can teach Cookie recipes and motions via the phone
premises.evidence_span: Chefs can use Cookie to teach it how they cook. They can specify the recipes step by step

premises.text: Meals priced around $4 with $600 device purchase or rental subscription undercut restaurant margins on fresh food
premises.evidence_span: A Serenity meal is typically priced at around $4 per meal. The app is free, and cookie will retail at $600

premises.text: Pre-portioned kits reduce household food waste and encourage healthier eating
premises.evidence_span: By pre-portioning just the right amount of healthy fresh ingredients into meal kits and reducing the amount of work required to prepare these meals, we not only help save people time, but we also help conserve food and encourage healthier eating habits

premises.text: Go-to-market starts with college students then expands to broader market
premises.evidence_span: deliver cookie and foodie first to college students and then to the broader market

value.text: Push-button fresh home-cooked meals with less time and skill
value.evidence_span: Cookie delivers that same experience in making home-cooked meals with multiple trays of fresh ingredients

secondary_value.text: Conserving food and encouraging healthier eating
secondary_value.evidence_span: help conserve food and encourage healthier eating habits

causal_links.evidence_span: limited time and ability to make food
cook a recipe meal from a recipe database without picking up a spatula
Our meals compete on price with mid-tier frozen meals, but the difference is that our meals are made with fresh ingredients and real food

notes: Type/amount/time/temperature/manipulation folded into one robotic cooking process package with the three hardware subsystems. Young professionals/moms/family-sharing uses treated as applications of the same convenience mechanism, not separate premises. Crowdfunding ask excluded. Demo failures do not add premises.
